relationships.subject: HO-1
relationships.evidence_quote: HO-1 promoted the activation of the cytoprotective enzyme Cyp3A11, which inhibited hepatic damage caused by NSA.

relationships.subject: HO-1
relationships.evidence_quote: HO-1 and Cyp3A11 formed a complex, as shown in Figure 5D, which was stronger in oxy-Hb-treated SS mice liver (Figure 5D).

relationships.subject: Kupffer cells
relationships.evidence_quote: Mechanistically, we found that SS mice were protected from cytotoxicity caused by NSA at baseline due to the significant activation of hepatic Kupffer cells, which produced heme-oxygenase 1 (HO-1).

relationships.subject: Kupffer cells
relationships.evidence_quote: This finding further confirms a macrophage-specific activation of these two proteins.

key_findings: Kupffer cell-derived HO-1 induces Cyp3A11 (Nrf2-independent) to protect SCD mice from NSA-induced acute liver damage.
Kupffer cell depletion reduced HO-1 and Cyp3A11, delaying injury resolution and increasing fibrosis.
